name: Amber Golem

source.note: An amber guardian for the Amber Temple on the 2014 Monster Manual stone golem's numbers. Entered from knowledge, not yet checked against the book. Its immunity to nonmagical, non-adamantine weapons is left out, as the 2024 golems drop it. Slow and Immutable Form are text only (the engine's save actions can't apply a hindrance without a condition, or repeat the save, yet).

languages: understands its creator's languages but can't speak

traits.name: Immutable Form
traits.summary: Effects that would change its shape don't work on it.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.summary: Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Magic Weapons
traits.summary: Its weapon attacks count as magical.

actions.name: Slow
actions.summary: Recharge 5-6. Creatures within 10 ft that see it: DC 17 Wis save or slowed for 1 minute (half Speed, no Reactions, one attack, an action or a Bonus Action).
actions.text: An affected creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. Text only for the engine.

summary: A towering construct of polished amber: two crushing fists and a pulse of magic that slows everyone near.
